name: Lima (Peru)

colors.symbolism: the field and the heraldic gold of the city arms
the crowned double-headed eagle of the arms

description: A yellow (gold) field bearing the arms of Lima — a black crowned double-headed eagle above a blue shield with three golden crowns and a star — granted to Lima by Charles V in 1537.
history: Lima, the 'City of Kings' (Ciudad de los Reyes), was founded in 1535 by Francisco Pizarro. The historic coat of arms was granted by Emperor Charles V in 1537.

features.role: Coat of arms of Lima (crowned double-headed eagle over a shield with three crowns and a star)
